title: Become the caress
caption:
In love, there is no past and no future. There is only now, and the now is eternity.

Technique 10 of 112. While caressing, become the caress. While kissing, be neither the kisser nor the kissed. Be the kiss, and love becomes a door out of time.

Save this and share it with someone you love.

Technique and sutra from Osho, The Book of Secrets.

.
